# Vendored JSON transport

json2.js, Douglas Crockford, 2023-05-10, Public Domain, no warranty.
Imported byte-for-byte from FSTR-Line feat/phase0-cep-poc commit 2cfb93fbb1ebc488ddf05471ab62b8d7606b68f5, blob b43526d343e49b0f79c56bbc9a1e652a00834be7.
Upstream: https://github.com/douglascrockford/JSON-js/blob/master/json2.js

The build embeds this ES3-compatible implementation in the host closure; it does not require or overwrite another extension's global JSON object. It is distributed with its original notice. Adobe documents the ExtendScript JSON boundary at https://blog.developer.adobe.com/en/publish/2018/04/cep-panels-and-json-objects .
